DRAWING NOTE

Existing rail clearance

The source flags 7 m at the boundary against its stated 30 m requirement.

Concept visualisation · not a construction or compliance modelNRL / POL

Sources & assumptions

This is a visual interpretation of the supplied tentative terminal plot plan, 20-09-2022, revision 02.

What follows the drawing

Facility arrangement, irregular boundary, entry and exit, rail corridor, future areas and the tank schedule. Product tank diameters, heights and stated stored capacities are transcribed from the schedule.

What is approximate

The drawing is marked NTS (not to scale). Positions and most footprints are manually traced from the page using an approximate scale calibrated against the 24 m HSD tank diameter. They are not survey coordinates. Buildings, walls, gantries, roofs, pumps and equipment fittings use illustrative heights and simplified shapes. No pipe routing, instrumentation or operating data is inferred.

Underground vessels

The cutaway shows the scheduled horizontal vessels below grade with a translucent surface. Burial depth is illustrative. Turn the cutaway off to hide these vessels.

Important source discrepancies

The drawing flags an existing rail/boundary clearance of 7 m against its stated 30 m requirement. This is reproduced as a historical drawing note, not a current standards assessment. The land requirement line gives 124,372.52 m² and “50 acre”; these are inconsistent (the stated square metres are approximately 30.73 acres). Neither figure is used to claim model accuracy.

Capacity and identifiers

Capacity cards use the schedule’s stated stored capacities, not cylinder volume. Model IDs such as HSD-01 are navigation identifiers added for this viewer, not verified plant tags. MS means motor spirit; HSD means high-speed diesel; ETP means effluent treatment plant.

Reference

The explorer and inspection layout was inspired by the reference engineering viewer. This model uses your terminal drawing, not the reference site's process equipment.
